messages:
Sophie K: Quick ping — noticed two issues on /docs/runtime-optimization today after the docs deploy:
- the 'batching config' snippet 404s (/assets/snippets/batching.yaml)
- the TypeScript example imports `redwood` but the fenced block is labeled python
Also search now omits 'prefix caching' from results even though the page contains that phrase. Anyone owns the runtime-optimization page? Link: https://docs.redwood.inference/internal/runtime-optimization

Michael T: I touched this page last quarter but didn't change snippets. I can take ownership if we need one. Which snippet path is 404ing exactly?

Sophie K: Snippet path printed in the console: /assets/snippets/batching.yaml. When I click the 'view snippet' button it tries that URL and CDN returns 404. Repro steps:
1) open the runtime-optimization page
2) click 'view snippet' on the "Batching config" card
3) check devtools network -> GET /assets/snippets/batching.yaml -> 404

Docsbot: automated-scan result -> dead_asset: /assets/snippets/batching.yaml; index_mismatch: 'prefix caching' not indexed on /docs/runtime-optimization (scan_ts=2054321100)

Ryan L: I have a local copy of batching.yaml from an earlier branch. I can open a quick PR to restore the snippet and fix the code-fence lang. @Michael T do you want to review?

Michael T: Please do, @Ryan L. Also @DevEx / @eng-infra can we re-run the docs indexer for that site after the PR merges? Looks like the index job might have missed that deploy window.

DevEx: pinged eng-infra to re-run indexer and check CDN sync. Will follow up in #eng-infra if there's an infra issue.

Sophie K: For the TS/python mismatch, here's the exact code block that's showing wrong:
```typescript
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood'
const c = RedwoodClient()
await c.generate('hi')
```
but the page is rendering it under ```python.

Ryan L: I'll bundle both fixes in the PR (restore /assets/snippets/batching.yaml and change the code fence lang to ts). Expect PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/457 (WIP). Will add notes for the reviewer and include the repro steps.

Michael T: Thanks. If anyone else notices flaky search slices or missing assets, drop them here and I'll triage. I'll review Ryan's PR as soon as it's ready.

Sophie K: Thanks everyone! :yellow_heart:

Docsbot: follow-up logged -> owner=Michael T; pr=https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/457; scan_followup=queued
